response.overview: When a determined English aristocrat hires a team of bounty hunters to guide her into the haunted bayous of 1870s Louisiana, they enter a land steeped in legend, where the sins of a cursed carnival still echo through the trees. As they delve deeper into the swamp's decaying heart, they find themselves hunted by grotesque highwaymen in killer clown greasepaint and stalked by something far older… a creature of blood and ritual, whispered about in fear. What begins as a search for a missing man becomes a brutal fight for survival, where faith, loyalty, and sanity are tested by the darkness that dwells just beneath the moss-draped surface.
response.tagline: Hunt it and it hunts you.
response.title: Grunch
